notes.title: Now Available - iBomber Defense Pacific
notes.notes:
iBomber Defense Pacific is Now Available on Steam and 20% off until Thursday March 8th 10AM PST.

iBomber moves to the Pacific as you fight a whole new enemy across the Pacific rim to regain freedom.

iBomber Defense Pacific takes tower defense to a whole new level and makes you feel like your right there and part of the incredible action. iBomber Defense Pacific has All New tactics, All New strategies, All New Maps, All New weapons and All New enemies.
